newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FIVE NEW LISTINGS ON THE VILNIUS BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: FIVE NEW LISTINGS ON THE VILNIUS BOURSE.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Tuesday that it decided to list five new stocks on its current list from August 25.
The bourse said in a statement that block trading and central market transactions will be allowed in the following ordinary shares:
- Utenos Beverages, 228,489 shares with a face value 100 litas each.
- Freda, 110,267 shares with 90 litas face value.
- Klaipedos Grudai, 2,251,608 shares with a face value of one litas.
- Finasta, 14,000 shares with a face value of 100 litas.
- Vingriai, 3,484,639 shares with a face value of five litas.
The bourse said that the financial situation of Vingriai should be taken into consideration since the firm posted losses for the first half of 1997.
